title: The Angel Levine
writer: Bill Gunn, Ronald Ribman, Bernard Malamud
actors: Zero Mostel, Harry Belafonte, Ida Kaminska
plot: Morris Mishkin is an elderly Jewish tailor plagued by hard times who prays to God for help and receives it in the person of a most unusual angel named Levine, a young, black, Jewish hustler from somewhere between Harlem and Heaven.
